title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Think about what happens when you have a fixed learning rate in gradient descent. How does it affect the convergence to a minimum? Consider the role of the learning rate in the speed and stability of convergence.

title: Global vs. Local Minimum
text: Remember that a global minimum is the lowest point in the entire function, while a local minimum is the lowest point in a specific region. Does gradient descent always find the global minimum?

title: Exploring Learning Rate
text: What might happen if the learning rate is too high or too low?
choices: It may not converge at all

title: Convergence of Gradient Descent
text: Does gradient descent always guarantee reaching the global minimum?
choices: Only if the function is convex
Only with a variable learning rate
